description: This file defines the main onboarding view for an iOS app using SwiftUI, handling user onboarding steps such as QR code scanning, manual setup, and connection status. It includes various UI components, state management, and logic for connecting to gateways and handling pairing.

classes.name: OnboardingStep
classes.description: Enum representing different onboarding steps with helper properties for navigation logic and UI labels.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardView
classes.description: Main SwiftUI view managing the onboarding process, including QR scanning, manual setup, connection status, and UI flow control.

classes.name: OnboardingModeRow
classes.description: A reusable SwiftUI view representing an onboarding mode option with checkmark indicator.

methods.name: handleScannedLink
methods.description: Processes a scanned QR code link, extracting connection parameters, updating state, and initiating connection.

methods.name: openQRScannerFromOnboarding
methods.description: Prepares and opens the QR code scanner sheet, resetting relevant connection state.

methods.name: resumeAfterPairingApproval
methods.description: Resumes the connection process after user approval of pairing, resetting relevant flags and retrying connection.

methods.name: attemptAutomaticPairingResumeIfNeeded
methods.description: Automatically attempts to resume pairing if certain conditions are met and enough time has passed.

methods.name: detectQRCode
methods.description: Detects and extracts a QR code message string from image data using CoreImage and CIDetector.

methods.name: advanceFromIntro
methods.description: Marks first run intro as seen and advances to the welcome step.

methods.name: navigateBack
methods.description: Navigates back to the previous onboarding step if available.

methods.name: connectDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Initiates connection to a discovered gateway device.

methods.name: selectMode
methods.description: Sets the selected connection mode and applies corresponding default settings.

methods.name: applyModeDefaults
methods.description: Applies default configuration settings for a selected connection mode.

methods.name: gatewayHasResolvableHost
methods.description: Checks if a gateway discovery results contains a resolvable host.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a manually specified host and port.

methods.name: retryLastAttempt
methods.description: Retries the last connection attempt, with optional silent mode.
